limitations: No local PowerShell executable; Windows CI provides executable acceptance.
The mock runs powershell.exe (5.1); the workflow runs pwsh (7).
checks: Simple choco function stores undeclared argument tokens through $args; unary comma retains each call as one nested array.
$global:LASTEXITCODE propagates the mocked native exit through the child scriptblock; the real workflow copies it immediately.
Functions shadow cmdlets; Start-Sleep, Test-Path and Out-File adapters do not perform actual sleeps, path probing or path writes.
The final PSCustomObject retains explicit array properties, including empty and singleton arrays; ConvertTo-Json depth 5 is sufficient.
Expected scenarios are immediate success; retry then success after delays 10,20; exhaustion after 3 calls; missing executable after a successful installation exit.
The pinned package/version is identical on each retry, final nonzero status throws and no missing executable is accepted.
New numeric token grammar separates digit groups with delimiters; it has no overlapping alternatives or repeated ambiguous whitespace.
Unit regexes operate on constant-size slices; label gaps and numeric tokens use forward scans; net mass scope uses the existing bounded context.
